author: ojiudezue
title: Overnight pass takes the never-vetoed default A on the false 'impossible move' flood
summary: Overnight pass takes the never-vetoed default A on the false 'impossible move' flood
context: The transit validator flags a room move implausible whenever any hallway camera fired in the last 10 min and none saw this move; it never checks that a camera covers the path. The flood rose from ~80/day to ~230/day after 11-14 and each false flag also cuts move confidence (music following).
why: Option A was offered 11-13 as the default with 'if you have not vetoed by the next session I take A', and three attended sessions passed without a veto. The card is Tier 2, so the overnight contract allows build-to-review but not deploy. A narrows the penalty to moves whose from/to room has its own shared camera, resolved through the registry, which keeps the real implausible case and removes the bedroom-to-own-bathroom noise.
implications: Fix built to review only on fix/anomaly-flood-transit-coverage; deploy waits for an attended session. Transit paths through a hallway between two uncovered rooms lose the implausible check (accepted: the validator never had topology).
revisit_trigger: If camera-covered implausible rows stay near zero after deploy, check whether the coverage resolver maps rooms to areas at all.
